text.jp:
……さあ、クリスタルに触れるのです。
はるかな異界の物語に、想いを馳せましょう。
text.official_en: Now, lay your hand upon the crystal, so it may weave a tale of a distant world.
text.real_en: Now, touch the crystal... and turn your thoughts to the tale of a distant world.

text.jp:
……力を求めし者よ。
よくぞ来ました。
text.official_en: Ah, yes, it was but a matter of time before you would find your way here.
text.real_en: ...You who seek power. Welcome.

text.jp:
あなたが彼らを知らずとも、心が響きあったなら
彼らのビジョンが、あなたの力となります。
text.official_en: Though you know not these heroes, they shall come to know you, and should your soul resonate with theirs, they shall lend you their strength.
text.real_en: Even if you do not know them, if your hearts resonate, their Visions will become your strength.

text.jp:
あなたとフリオニールは、とてもよく似て
たがいの想いが共鳴するでしょう。
text.official_en: You and he are similar in many ways, and the two of you complement each other exceedingly well.
text.real_en: You and Firion are very much alike. Your feelings will surely resonate.

text.jp:
あなたとフリオニールは、少し違うけれど
異なる想いが響きあうでしょう。
text.official_en: While you and he have your differences, those differences will ultimately prove to be your greatest strength.
text.real_en: You and Firion are a little different, but your different feelings will resonate with each other.

text.jp:
あなたなら、ビジョンの力を正しく使えるはず。
信じていますよ……。
text.official_en: I have the utmost faith you will wield his power with all the wisdom it is due.
text.real_en: I believe you can use the power of Visions wisely...

text.jp:
あやつる武器をひとつに決めず、いろいろな
武器を試すことで、可能性が広がります。
text.official_en: A fine decision, indeed, as the more weapons in one’s arsenal, the more doors are likely to open for them.
text.real_en: Rather than settle on a single weapon, you would try all kinds of weapons to expand your possibilities.

text.jp:
ありがとう……。
想いを、たしかに受け取りました。
text.official_en: Thank you for those glimpses into your soul. Now then...
text.real_en: Thank you... I have received your feelings.

text.jp: いつかわかりあえると信じる
text.official_en: Trust they would see reason.
text.real_en: Believe you will understand one another someday.

text.jp:
いまではなく、ここでもない異界で
人々の記憶に残る、幻想の英雄たち……。
text.official_en:
A reliquary for the memories of heroes fantastical in nature—
scattered across myriad realms and epochs.
text.real_en: Heroes of legend, remembered by people in other worlds, in times and places far removed from our own...

text.jp:
ここはビジョンクリスタルの祠……
異界につながる聖域です。
text.official_en: Welcome to the Vision Crystal Sanctum—a nexus between planes of existence...
text.real_en: This is the Vision Crystal Sanctum... a sacred place connected to other worlds.

text.jp:
これからの問いかけに
あなたの想いを、答えてください。
text.official_en: Henceforth, I shall pose to you three questions.
text.real_en: Answer the questions I am about to ask with what is in your heart.

text.jp: さまざまな武器を試す
text.official_en: Experiment with different weapons.

text.jp:
それでも心のどこかでレオンハルトを信じ、
ふたたび肩を並べて、ともに戦ったのです。
text.official_en: Yet, in spite of all his reservations, Firion found the strength to believe in his friend—for which he was duly rewarded.
text.real_en: Deep down, he still believed in Leon, and they eventually fought side by side again.

text.jp:
それでも戦えるなら、あなたもフリオニールと
同じく、戦いの果てに自由を勝ち取るでしょう。
text.official_en: If you are able to continue in the face of such adversity—much as Firion did—freedom shall more than likely be yours in due time.

text.jp: それは、侵略に抗い自由を願う異界の記憶――
text.official_en: The people of this realm were locked in a struggle where their very freedom was at stake.
text.real_en: These are memories of another world, where people yearned for freedom and resisted an invasion—

text.jp:
そんなフリオニールたちの道を切り開こうと
反乱軍の人々が、次々と命を落としていきます。
text.official_en: As Firion and his fellow adventurers walked the paths they chose, some of their comrades in arms inevitably lost their lives.
text.real_en: One after another, members of the rebel army gave their lives to clear a path for Firion and his companions.

text.jp:
そんな彼らの前に、かつての仲間が
思わぬかたちで、立ちはだかります。
text.official_en: As this transpired, however, they were confronted by a new foe—an erstwhile ally.

text.jp:
ただフリオニールは、裏切りに憤りながらも
非情には、なりきれませんでした。
text.official_en: Conversely, while Firion was far from pleased that his friend had betrayed him, he opted for a kinder alternative.
text.real_en: Firion was angry at the betrayal, but he could not bring himself to be ruthless.

text.jp: ためらわず前に進みつづける
text.official_en: Stay the course and carry on.

text.jp:
でも人々は、帝国の暴虐に耐えられず……
フリオニールは彼らのために戦いました。
text.official_en: Unlike you, however, the people could not endure the emperor’s tyranny; that is why Firion fought.

text.jp:
ともに戦った人々が、自分たちを支えるため
次々と犠牲になる――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were the people who pledged themselves to your cause—who fought alongside you—to be struck down, one after the other, how would you react?
text.real_en: If the people who fought beside you sacrificed themselves, one after another, to support your struggle... what would you do?

text.jp:
どんな言葉であろうと、心を開いて
想いを示せば、それは絆となります。
text.official_en: Answer them truthfully and you shall forge a bond with that hero, regardless of what those words are.
text.real_en: Whatever words you choose, open your heart and express your feelings. That will form a bond.

text.jp:
ひたむきに挑む裏表のない想いが、裏切った
レオンハルトの心の闇に、光を投げかけました。
text.official_en: As he appeared before Leon with the intent to combat him, the sincerity of Firion’s conviction cast light on the darkness that enshrouded Leon’s heart.
text.real_en: Firion's sincere, unwavering determination cast light into the darkness in Leon's heart after his betrayal.

text.jp: もう犠牲を出さないよう努める
text.official_en: Try to limit casualties whenever possible.

text.jp:
フリオニールたちも、痛みを乗り越えて
苦難に耐える力を養いました。
text.official_en: Firion and his comrades understood this, and overcame much pain and suffering thanks to their mutual trust.
text.real_en: Firion and his companions endured pain and developed the strength to withstand hardship.

text.jp:
フリオニールの想いはビジョンとなって
きっとあなたの希望となります。
text.official_en: His thoughts shall coalesce into a vision, which will, in turn, bestow upon you hope.

text.jp:
フリオニールは「のばら」を合言葉に、
反乱軍をまとめ、帝国に立ち向かいます。
text.official_en: By uttering the phrase “Wild Rose,” Firion was able to gain the trust of many like-minded individuals.
text.real_en: Using “Wild Rose” as their password, Firion united the rebels and stood against the empire.

text.jp:
フリオニールも、さまざまな武器を手に取り
戦いの中で熟練していったのです。
text.official_en: Firion, too, honed his skill with numerous weapons—a tactic which afforded him a great advantage in battle.
text.real_en: Firion, too, wielded different weapons, growing more skilled with each battle.

text.jp: 争いを避けて耐える
text.official_en: Avoid conflict and endure tyranny.

text.jp: 仲間と鍛えあう
text.official_en: Train together with your allies.

text.jp:
信じあう仲間だからこそ、手加減することなく
おたがいを厳しく高めあうことができます。
text.official_en: Companions who fully trust each other exert themselves all the more, thus allowing everyone’s skills to improve apace.
text.real_en: Because companions trust one another, they can push each other to improve without holding back.

text.jp: 合言葉で味方を集める
text.official_en: Suss out like-minded individuals by using a password.
text.real_en: Gather allies using a password.

text.jp:
困難で、勇気ある選択です。フリオニールも
レオンハルトの裏切りに衝撃を受けましたが……
text.official_en: A bold choice—and a difficult one to make. It was hard for Firion too, as Leon’s betrayal shook him to his core.
text.real_en: A difficult, courageous choice. Firion was shaken by Leon’s betrayal, too, but...

text.jp:
強大な帝国に勝つために、反乱軍の一員として
自分にできることを、さがすとしたら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you a member of a small rebel force that was tasked with felling an imperial juggernaut, how would you endeavor to lay this gargantuan enemy low?
text.real_en: If you joined a rebel army and sought what you could do to defeat a mighty empire... what would you do?

text.jp:
彼の名は、フリオニール……。
あなたの想いが、彼との絆になる。
text.official_en: One of those young survivors was Firion, and it is with him you shall endeavor to forge a bond.
text.real_en: His name was Firion... Your feelings will form a bond with him.

text.jp:
心を解き放ち、自由に答えてください。
もしも、あなたが――
text.official_en: Now cast off the fetters of inhibition, bare your soul, and answer from your heart.
text.real_en: Open your heart and answer freely. Now, suppose you...

text.jp:
戦いに散った人々を忘れることなく、
彼らが遺した想いを受け継ぐために……。
text.official_en: In the end, his comrades would not be forgotten in death, for he would do all that he could to bring their dreams to fruition.
text.real_en: He could never forget those who died in battle. He fought on to carry their hopes with him...

text.jp:
戦いの中で行方不明になった仲間が
強敵となって、現れたら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to lose one of your trusted colleagues, only to have them appear before you as an adversary much later, what would you do?
text.real_en: If a comrade who went missing in battle returned as a powerful enemy... what would you do?

text.jp: 戦ってでも目を覚まさせる
text.official_en: Bring them to their senses, even if you must fight them.

text.jp:
戦場を生き延びて反乱軍にくわわり
帝国に立ち向かう若者がいました。
text.official_en: After one such nation was invaded, a handful of its surviving youths would join the fight against the empire.
text.real_en: A young man survived the battlefield, joined the rebel army and rose against the empire.

text.jp:
支配に抗う異界の幻影　フリオニール
裏切りの戦場を越えて、自由をもたらす。
text.official_en:
Freedom Fighter Firion
The rebel who triumphed over treachery and ushered in an age of liberation.
text.real_en: An otherworldly Vision who resists oppression: Firion. He brings freedom beyond a battlefield scarred by betrayal.

text.jp:
敵が巨大でもあきらめず、小さな一歩を
重ねて成長する、フリオニールたち。
text.official_en: The difference in ability between the rebels and the empire was at first chasmic, but the rebels slowly closed the gap.
text.real_en: Despite the enemy’s overwhelming might, Firion and his companions never gave up, growing through small steps forward.

text.jp:
敵を攻撃するだけでなく、ひそかに味方と
つながっていく、そんな戦い方もあります。
text.official_en: Though by no means as dramatic as physical combat, the act of garnering support is no less important during a rebellion.
text.real_en: Not every battle involves attacking the enemy. You can also forge secret connections with your allies.

text.jp:
犠牲を減らすため、争いを避けて耐える。
あなたは並外れた強い心の持ち主ですね。
text.official_en: The extent of your resolve is laudable. There is nary a soul in any world who would elect to walk this treacherous path.
text.real_en: You would avoid fighting and endure hardships to reduce casualties. That takes extraordinary strength of heart.

text.jp:
犠牲を背負って、それでも進むのですね。
フリオニールも、同じ道を選びました。
text.official_en: You would shoulder the burden of their sacrifice, yet keep it from weighing you down...much as Firion did.
text.real_en: You would carry the weight of their sacrifice and keep moving forward. Firion chose the same path.

text.jp: 裏切った者は許せない
text.official_en: Certainly not forgive them.
text.real_en: I could never forgive a traitor.

text.jp:
裏切った者を信じる勇気、あるいは倒す覚悟。
どんな道を選んでも、想いの強さが試されます。
text.official_en: Whether you choose to trust your betrayer or to do battle with them, of one thing you can be certain: either path will test your conviction.

text.jp:
裏切りの罪は許せない。それは信じてくれる
人々を守るための、厳しい姿勢ですね
text.official_en: That stance is a stern one to take. It can also, however, be a necessary one to protect all those who believe in you.
text.real_en: To refuse to forgive betrayal is a stern stance, one taken to protect those who place their trust in you.

text.jp:
語りあうより戦うことで伝わる想いもある。
フリオニールも、そう考えたのでしょう。
text.official_en: At times, a single fight does more to convince than a thousand words, and Firion likely believed this to be one of them.

text.jp:
誰も犠牲にしないと誓っても、現実は厳しく
打ちのめされることもあるはずです。
text.official_en: Pragmatism over idealism—while you may strive to prevent all casualties, the reality is that they will occur.
text.real_en: Even if you swear there will be no more sacrifices, reality can be cruel and may break your spirit.

text.jp:
邪悪な皇帝が率いる帝国が、国々を滅ぼし
人々の自由をふみにじる、戦乱の世界。
text.official_en: The empire, led by a most nefarious monarch, would dispatch troops to neighboring countries with the intent to crush them underfoot.
text.real_en: A world at war, where an empire led by an evil emperor destroyed nations and trampled upon their freedom.
